main_measure.name: slope of excess 5-bar forward return on forecast, pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; at least 200 non-overlapping grid cases

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2 over at least 200 grid cases (confirm rule).
reading: Cases are grid bars 0,5,10,... of each window with t+5 in the window and a non-missing forecast (zero forecasts included); each coin's drift is the mean of its grid 5-bar returns over all its windows; the slope and its t come from a pooled OLS with an intercept.
